messages.content: Write an announcement telling customers that a service is moving to a new platform next quarter. Around 250 words.

**Subject: [Service] moves to [New Platform] in [Q2]**

We're moving [Service] to [New Platform] next quarter. Your account, your history, and your saved settings move with you. You won't need to export anything.

The current system was built in [2017] and we've outgrown it. Adding a feature means touching six places, and outages take longer to fix than they should. Rather than keep patching, we're rebuilding on [New Platform], where the same work takes days instead of months.

Here's what changes for you:

- New URL — [app.example.com]. The old one redirects for 12 months.
- Sign-in switches to [SSO/email link]. Your password stops working on [date].
- The [reports] screen is redesigned. Everything else looks the same.
- [API v1] keeps running through [December 2027]. We'll publish the v2 guide in [March].

Pricing stays the same, so does your plan, your data retention, and the people you email when something breaks.

The move happens on [date] between [02:00 and 06:00 UTC]. Expect roughly [two hours] where the service is read-only. We'll post live status at [status.example.com], and we'll email you 14 days ahead, then again the morning of.

If you've built anything on top of [Service] — scripts, integrations, a dashboard that scrapes our exports — reply to this email and tell us. We'd rather hear about it now than have it break on you at 3am. We're setting aside engineering time in [March] specifically to help customers with custom setups.

Questions go to [migration@example.com].

— [Name], [Title]
